This app is a **static Vite SPA**. Production does not run Node. nginx on the DigitalOcean origin serves `dist/`; Cloudflare holds visitor TLS and talks to the origin with your Origin CA cert (covers `*.ingame.global`, valid through 2036). Live camera on phones needs this HTTPS URL.

DNS for `fanta-dmasl26-421419912123poc.ingame.global` is **already on Cloudflare** (same edge IPs as Core). The origin vhost is what is still missing. I could not SSH from here — this environment has no droplet IP or SSH key. Production build is ready locally.

## Requisites

| Need | Why |
|------|-----|
| Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 droplet | Reuse the existing IGE origin if this hostname already points there. 1 vCPU / 1 GB is enough. |
| SSH as `root` (key login) | Same pattern as IGE Vision. |
| Cloudflare zone `ingame.global` | Orange-cloud proxy on. SSL/TLS mode **Full (strict)** — not Flexible. |
| Origin cert pair | `ingameglobal.pem` + `ingameglobal.key` from Downloads. Do not commit the key. |
| Node 20+ **on this PC only** | `npm run build`. Not needed on the droplet. |
| OpenSSH (`ssh`, `scp`) | Built into Windows. |
| DO firewall | Inbound **22 / 80 / 443**. |

No Postgres, Redis, Docker, or PM2.

## Cloudflare (once)

1. DNS → A record `fanta-dmasl26-421419912123poc` → **droplet public IP**, proxy **on**.
2. SSL/TLS → **Full (strict)**.
3. If the record already exists from a wildcard, skip DNS and only add the nginx vhost.

## Deploy from this PC

```powershell
cd "C:\Dev IGE\fanta-web-app"
.\deploy\publish.ps1 -DropletHost YOUR.DROPLET.IP -WithCerts
```

Add `-IdentityFile C:\path\to\id_ed25519` if the key is not the default.

If this droplet **already** has the Origin cert (IGE Vision uses `/etc/nginx/ssl/`, sandbox uses `/etc/ssl/ingameglobal/`), omit `-WithCerts`.

That script builds `dist/`, installs nginx + the vhost, copies certs if asked, and syncs files to `/var/www/fanta`. Later updates:

```powershell
.\deploy\publish.ps1 -DropletHost YOUR.DROPLET.IP
```

## What lands on the server

- Site: `/etc/nginx/sites-available/fanta`
- Files: `/var/www/fanta`
- Certs: `/etc/nginx/ssl/ingameglobal.pem` + `.key` (or the existing IGE path; setup rewrites the vhost)

Manual copy-paste is in `deploy/README.md`. nginx config is `deploy/nginx.conf`.


From anywhere: `https://fanta-dmasl26-421419912123poc.ingame.global/` should return HTML. Open that **https** URL on a phone for camera.
